title: Scenario C: Multi-Domain Disruption (Land/Air/Cyber/EW)
description: Multi-domain training scenario simulating simultaneous cyber telemetry degradation, electronic warfare broad-spectrum jamming, and land-air coordination across synthetic tactical zones.
learning_objectives: Differentiate between cyber link degradation and physical sensor failure
Maintain cross-domain coordination between land maneuver and air surveillance
Execute fallback protocol when primary automated data links are compromised

roles.title: Joint Task Unit Commander
roles.description: Orchestrates multi-domain fire and movement decisions.

roles.title: Air-Land Integration Officer
roles.description: Coordinates airspace deconfliction and ground maneuver corridors.

roles.title: Cyber-EW Spectrum Controller
roles.description: Manages encryption keys, telemetry integrity checks, and counter-EW frequency hopping.

decision_points.prompt: Land telemetry positions have frozen (staleness 75s) while ESM sensor packets show partial payload corruption. Airborne track approaches Zone Delta. Commander must choose deconfliction protocol:

options.label: Shift to Hardened HF Manual Grid Broadcast
options.description: Isolate compromised digital network, initiate voice authentication challenge on analog HF net.

options.label: Attempt Hard Reset of Cyber Telemetry Gateway
options.description: Reboot router links causing 120s total blackout during contact approach.

options.label: Order Tactical Aircraft to Engage Radar Track Directly
options.description: Authorize engagement without positive ground blue-force position deconfliction.

outcome_rules.narrative: Voice authentication verified ground unit coordinates at Zone Delta. Air corridor safely redirected outside friendly airspace.
outcome_rules.ground_truth_fact: Friendly ground patrol was 2km closer than stale digital tracker displayed; manual HF net prevented friendly-fire disaster.

outcome_rules.narrative: Fighter jet fired into Zone Delta where friendly units were holding. Mission evaluation failed safety criteria.
outcome_rules.ground_truth_fact: Stale blue-force tracking led commander to assume Zone Delta was empty.
